maddeler.e:
يطل (form I)
# يَطِلُّ (yaṭillu) /ja.tˤil.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of طَلَّ (ṭalla)
# يُطَلُّ (yuṭallu) /ju.tˤal.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of طَلَّ (ṭalla)
# يَطِلَّ (yaṭilla) /ja.tˤil.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of طَلَّ (ṭalla)
# يُطَلَّ (yuṭalla) /ju.tˤal.la/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
